title: Shinonome Akito — Tag Terror〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, does here look good?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but... It's a little surprising how we can't use our usual park.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're doing maintenance on the playground equipment, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, but I was worried that the park was being closed down after seeing that “under construction” sign.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'd be just as put out as the neighborhood kids if that happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, let's change gears and start getting ready for today's practice...
Woof...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, look! That dog's coming this way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof! Woof...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Hey, Shinonome!
Max, stop and sit.

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Pant... Pant...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Ishihara, Max.
I haven't seen you guys since that competition.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How's your ankle feeling? Better?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's all better now.
But I'm a little out of shape, so I'm here to rehab by doing some light running.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, aren't you gonna introduce us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this the dog and owner you told us about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is Ishihara and Max.
Ishihara, these guys are...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Your team, right? You guys sing together?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? I don't remember telling you about them...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Hanasato and Kamishiro told me.
They talked about how you guys are working really hard to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: After the competition, I wanted to hear you guys sing, so I had a friend take me to a live house.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that event we did the next town over. You were there?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yeah! My friend and I were totally blown away...! Even after that event ended, we couldn't stop talking about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I wish Max could've also been there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dogs have way better hearing than humans, right? Wouldn't it have been too loud for him?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He's tilting his head. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, Akito, he's been looking at you and wagging his tail this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what if he wants you to pet him...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
P-Pet him...?
I feel like he was just tilting his head inquisitively...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You'll stay still for me, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Pant... Pant...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, you really are one smart dog...

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, can we pet him too?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Hehe. Hello, Max.

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Pant...! Pant...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, are you really that surprised...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... Seeing you pet a real dog like this, Akito... I feel like a hot spring is going to burst out of this park tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A hot spring?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, what are your guys' plans moving forward? Still planning on becoming the best team in the country?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Of course! Hearing you guys sing made me feel even more motivated! We actually just registered for our next competition yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: And good luck with your dream, you guys! We'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks. And you need to help get Max a win!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yeah, we plan on winning next time!
